name: GA-08
label: Safe R

key_factors: Incumbent Austin Scott running with a large cash advantage
Democratic challenger is minimally funded ($19K raised)
model.rationale: Austin Scott holds a heavily Republican seat with over $1.3 million on hand, while Kelly Esti has raised under $20,000 and shows no outside support. With no competitive polling or expert ratings suggesting otherwise, the fundamentals point to a comfortable Republican win.
model.watch: Any late surge in Democratic fundraising or outside spending, or a major scandal involving the incumbent, would be the main way this race tightens.
notes: No expert rater lists this race; treated as safe for the party holding the seat.
No usable general-election polls; forecast rests on fundamentals and expert ratings.

overview:
Georgia's 8th District leans strongly Republican, and incumbent Austin Scott is seeking another term with the advantages that come with it. He has raised over $1.1 million and holds $1.3 million in cash, while Democratic challenger Kelly Esti has raised about $19,000 with almost nothing banked. No outside groups are meaningfully involved on either side.

Prediction markets give Scott roughly a 95% chance of winning, and no expert raters list the race as competitive. With no public polling available, the outlook rests on the district's partisan lean, the incumbent's financial dominance, and the challenger's lack of resources, all of which point to a safe Republican hold.
